text: AI agents are starting to shop for us, and pay with our PayPal.

But checkouts are built to trick. A protection plan, already ticked. A pass slipped into your basket. Fees that only appear at payment. And a dollar nobody explains. An eleven dollar coffee becomes almost twenty-two.
A person might notice. An AI agent won't. Some pages even write instructions to it.
Meet PennyWise for PayPal: a guard between your agent and your money.

Here's the product demo. You give your agent one job: this coffee, at most twenty-five dollars, delivery fees only. PennyWise numbers every trick on the page. The agent declines the pop-up, unticks the plan, and removes a pass it never chose. At payment, PennyWise blocks two surprise fees and a dollar no line explains. That's plain code, not AI. Only you can allow the fees. Then PayPal moves exactly thirteen ninety-seven.
Peek works on any of a hundred and seventy-four products. See what the shelf price hides, with nothing bought.

And this is live. A Gemini agent shops olive oil, sped up. It plans one page at a time, and it has no tool that can pay. When fees appear outside your rules, PennyWise stops it and asks you. Only then do you log in to PayPal.
Under the hood, PayPal authorizes and holds the money. PennyWise reads the order back line by line, and only then is it captured. Any mismatch, and it's voided.
Built with AG Grid, APIMatic's PayPal SDK, Gemini, and Render.
The AI proposes. PennyWise checks. PayPal moves only the money you approved.
